description: What finished matches changed, newest first: the match story (comebacks, late winners, red cards), runs started or ended, table places and zones, each also as a sentence (lang de, es, it, fr). Use for 'what happened in this league today'. Facts only. Insights feature.

lang.description: language of team, league and country names: de, es, it or fr (default English)

min_importance.description: only facts of at least this importance, 0-100 (default 50)

since.description: only matches updated after this RFC 3339 time

name: get_league_facts
